8a1(sna tshogs): @#//byang chub sems dpa' shes rab spyod pa ji ltar brtson//phung po khams la rdul tsam brtson par mi byed cing //phung por mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpa'i yon//gang zhig chos 'di grub par bsgrub

8b4(sna tshogs): zhig yongs su brjod//rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig 'dri tshe//spobs pa slad dang rnam pa du ma 'byung 'gyur zhing //'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang //yongs su nyams par 'gyur 
8b5(sna tshogs): ba 'di ni bdud kyi las//'di bshad tshe na kha cig som nyi za 'gyur te//'dren pas 'dir ni bdag gi ming yang yongs ma brjod//rigs dang sa dang rus kyang yongs su ma brjod ces//'di ni nyan par mi 'gyur spong 'gyur

8b7(sna tshogs): no//dper na la las ro brgya ldan pa'i zas rnyed la//zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan tshol bar byed pa ltar//byang chub sems dpa' pha rol phyin pa 'di rnyed nas//dgra bcom sa yis byang chub tshol byed de bzhin 
8b8(sna tshogs): no//bsti stang 'dod par 'gyur zhing rnyed pa 'dod 'gyur dang //lha dang bcas pa'i sems kyis khyim 'dis byed ldan zhing //chos brtad nas ni chos min bya ba spyod 'gyur ba//lam po ras mgo la 'gro ba 'di ni bdud 
9a1(sna tshogs): @#//kyi las//gang dag de yi tshe na 'dun cing dad gyur nas//chos kyi dam pa 'di ni rten du song ba las//snod ni bcud kyi phyag rgya dang gnas//dam pa med cing de yi dam pa thams

9a3(sna tshogs): 'byung bar 'gyur//rin chen rin thang med pa rnyed 'gyur gang dag yin//de dag dkon la dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang //de bzhin rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog/rin chen chos kyang dkon

9a8(sna tshogs): shes rab pha rol phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen//mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas sam mya ngan 'das kyang rung //chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stong pa'i gnas te//byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin
